title: kbs ready semantics: status-blind and ignores closed blockers
description:
Implementation appears to return every non-closed issue without a blocked-by edge, including Backlog, In Progress, and In Review—not only workflow-ready/open issues.

Also, any blocked-by edge keeps an issue excluded even after the dependency is closed; the edge must be manually removed.

If intentional, document prominently. Otherwise readiness should account for workflow status and dependency completion.
right_now_summary: The readiness check ignores workflow status and still excludes issues after their blockers are closed.
